thanks.headline: Your seat is held.
thanks.lead: Thank you. Stripe is emailing your receipt now. Here is what happens next.
steps: Within one business day I email you three short questions about the initiative you'll bring. That's the fit check. If the cohort isn't right for you, I say so and refund you in full.
The day the eighth seat is taken, everyone gets the six Wednesday dates. Sessions run 9:30am PT.
If the cohort doesn't fill, you get every dollar back. No forms, no follow-up required.
thanks.callLabel: Rather do the fit check live? Book 30 minutes.

offer.name: Product Sense Cohort
offer.when: Six Wednesdays at 9:30am PT. We start the week after the eighth seat is taken, and you get the dates that day.
offer.what: One real decision of yours a week, from the initiative you own, tested in a questions-only hot seat. The room tests your reasoning, not your roadmap: name the tension, not the feature. Your seat lands on the week of your weakest dimension. Pair rounds every week, so nothing goes untested.
